Despite transcript retrieval failing and the context being unclear, the orchestrator did not ask WebSurfer or Assistant to clarify the timing or seek an alternative primary source. This demonstrates FM-2.2 (Fail to Ask for Clarification): acting on incomplete, ambiguous information and not requesting clarification before finalizing the answer.
